title: Stability case (tpt-yard stability)
description: Input of `tpt-yard stability`: a hull (an offsets CSV, or prismatic coefficients) plus a loading condition. Written by `tpt-yard new-hull` and `tpt-yard import-hull`; see test-data/stability/. Command-line flags override the loading fields.

offsets_csv.description: Path to a hull-offsets CSV (see hull-offsets.table-schema.json), relative to this file. Wins over `hull` when both are given.

hull.description: Prismatic screening model, used when no offsets table is given. Far cruder than offsets: Cwp/Cb stand in for the real form.

depth_m.description: Only used to default the draft (65 %) and KG (55 %) when `loading` omits them.

kg_m.description: Centre of gravity above the baseline.

$comment: Without `hull.depth_m`, `loading.draft_m` and `loading.kg_m` are required (or the --draft/--kg flags).
